title: Find Pivot Index
summary: Find the leftmost index where the sum of everything before it equals the sum of everything after it.

tests.explain: Left of index 3: 2 + 3 + -1 = 4. Right of it: 4. No earlier index balances.
No index has equal sums on both sides, so return -1.
Nothing is left of index 0 (sum 0), and 3 + -3 = 0 on the right.

hints: Summing both sides from scratch for every index is O(n²). What do you already know when you move from index i to i + 1?
Compute the total once. If leftSum is the sum before index i, the sum after it is total - leftSum - nums[i].
Walk left to right keeping leftSum. Return the first i where leftSum === total - leftSum - nums[i], then add nums[i] to leftSum.

complexity.time: O(n): one pass for the total, one pass to find the pivot
